description: Source code for the SystemService in the Mattermost plugin API, providing methods to query system properties, manage plugin assets, licenses, and generate metadata.

classes.name: SystemService
classes.description: Provides methods to query system properties and manage plugin-related data.

methods.name: GetManifest
methods.description: Returns the plugin manifest from the bundle.

methods.name: GetBundlePath
methods.description: Returns the absolute path where the plugin bundle was unpacked.

methods.name: GetPluginAssetURL
methods.description: Builds a URL to a plugin asset in the assets directory.

methods.name: GetServerVersion
methods.description: Returns the current Mattermost server version.

methods.name: IsEnterpriseReady
methods.description: Checks if the server is configured as Enterprise Ready.

methods.name: GetSystemInstallDate
methods.description: Returns the installation date of the server.

methods.name: GetDiagnosticID
methods.description: Returns a unique diagnostic report identifier (deprecated).

methods.name: GetTelemetryID
methods.description: Returns a unique telemetry report identifier.

methods.name: RequestTrialLicense
methods.description: Requests and installs a trial license if server version is >= 5.36.

methods.name: GeneratePacketMetadata
methods.description: Generates and saves metadata for customer packets in YAML format.
